folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B319: whole-owner coverage and current chain boundaries
folds.body:
The whole724-line owner is now content-reviewed, closing its earlier selected-section status. All original code families and tables, X1–X19, FC1–FC7, the adopted FS reference, MF1–MF37, MW1–MW9 and the earlier field reconciliation were read. Later corrections govern earlier claims: MDF's importer/path counts, universal assembly shape, simple stat rollup, free recoverable parts, averaged truth, reveal-only freezing, uniform priority, inferred old-item ancestry, universal vial and whole-chain closed form were already narrowed in X/FC. Do not resurrect them as current requirements.

Current AD51 supersedes the repeated two-consumer landing prerequisite and MA5's three-user threshold. A reasonable shared seam may serve the first useful selected consumer; another case validates and revises it. This does not authorize a universal crafting/rules/body/spell engine or make every domain identical. Current scope retires the old first-realm/first-prestige milestone, and the selected book-world/testbed direction qualifies the historical Village proof ranking. The active opening paragraph is updated, with its exact old wording preserved in the batch amendments; dated round text remains intact. Old per-slice dispatch/merge/push instructions and named running workers grant no present action authority.

ML/MS/MV/MMR/MX remain palettes. Bodies, materials, people, techniques, legal claims and currency do not become the same reducer because each has references or slots. A tag selects where an actual law applies; it neither grants permission nor provides composition, units, true eligibility or a power. An institution's ban produces its supported enforcement consequences rather than physically preventing the act by itself. Unknown properties can act before discovery. A character can attempt an unobserved harvest through actual supported means; MS1 is not a universal must-see permission gate. Blind handling, indirect sensing and broad powers follow their mechanisms. Debug truth and in-fiction knowledge projections differ, including existence leaks from sealed IDs.

Units, yield, fit, response quality, damage, byproducts and recovery need their particular world/method law. A stronger process can genuinely repair, purify, duplicate or bypass ordinary costs where supported. There is no universal bad-input ceiling, copy-drift tax, inevitable waste/byproduct, compulsory failed-work reward, slowest-player rule, lost-XP shortcut or forced trace/capacity price. CS and early MT/KS examples are dials, not mandatory balancing penalties. Display provenance can be summarized without merging distinct truth or destroying exact material history where a consumer needs it. Meaningless unused debris need not become a new compulsory pollution mechanic simply to satisfy a generic reader slogan.

FS1–FS9's dated adoption applies to the content explicitly adopted in its referenced fold proposal, not every later paragraph or Minecraft mechanism. Keep actual lot-held progress, staffed work versus passive physical change, committed stage outputs, recoverable containers and collection custody. Cancel, pause, support loss, exposure and movement may have different outcomes at each stage. Closed form is valid only within the modeled constant segment, with actual shared causal boundaries and unsettled time preserved; no wall-clock/offline or frozen-world progress follows from a chain plan. Current AD52 compresses routine inputs while preserving real costs, elapsed consequences and important decisions; it does not require a first manual run or a new plan engine for every operation.

The later HV1/T2/T3 merged records qualify earlier running/unmerged statuses. MF's successive requested deliveries qualify its earlier research-only applications for the exact original local adaptations and later routes, not complete Minecraft mods or all-world production. Preserve native stock, helpers' independent custody, funded wages versus earned wages, exact reservations, room rights, actual route legs, exposed drying and the separate meanings of weather/service calendar. The2470/2486 test counts, nineteen native groups and eight roundtrips are dated reported checks on their named inputs. The populated workshop fixture is explicitly not a natural-opening journey, and installed-font evidence is not proof of a freshly installed current app. No linked release/input artifact was reread here.

MW rows are later proposals. Graded maintenance loss is GT5U's selected law, not a mandatory world-wide tax; an actual station can pause, reset, degrade or keep running for its real reason. A plan may include incoming promises in a forecast while retaining their due time, route, failure and reserved recipient capacity; a promised delivery is not already received spendable stock. A derived cheat value, trader quote and material property have different owners. Capacity rationing, pollution decay, two-axis containers and property-derived pricing need the selected actual consumer; the table's old missing-owner statements are not current source inspection or permission to create duplicate ledgers.

The earlier G7 field fold retains its earlier source/test scope. In particular, local capped harm, injected stat writes and interval rain sampling are not fresh whole-body exposure, all-weather-history or general catch-up proof. A field may continue after staffed work stops only through its actual clock/mechanism. No current source, test, browser, save, private artifact, module, process, chain, world priority, deletion or merge was changed by this review beyond the scoped documentation maintenance.
